原电池：单液到双液: Galvanic Cells: From One Solution to Two
Zn − 2e⁻ = Zn²⁺ · 电子从负极经导线到正极 · 盐桥补离子通路: Zn − 2e⁻ = Zn²⁺ · electrons flow from the negative electrode through the wire to the positive · the salt bridge completes the ion path
同一杯稀硫酸里已经有电流了，为什么还要换成两杯、再加一根盐桥？: There's already a current in one beaker of dilute sulfuric acid. Why switch to two beakers and add a salt bridge?
氧化与还原不在同一片溶液里发生: Oxidation and reduction don't happen in the same solution
电子从 Zn 经导线到 Cu，电流方向相反: Electrons go from Zn through the wire to Cu; the current flows the opposite way
锌与酸直接反应，电流逐渐衰减: Zinc reacts directly with the acid, and the current gradually decays
盐桥补离子通路: Salt bridge completes the ion path
两池各管一半反应，电压更高、电流更稳: Each beaker handles half the reaction: higher voltage, steadier current
两套装置 + 一台电流表 + 一个示意放大: Two setups + one ammeter + one magnified view
整体 · 同一张台面上一杯酸与两杯酸的区别: Overview · on one bench, the difference between one beaker of acid and two beakers
拨一个开关，电流表、气泡和箭头一起变: Flip a switch and the ammeter, bubbles and arrows change together
全对！两池分开是为了让电子只走导线，盐桥补的是离子通路。: All correct! The two beakers are separated so electrons only travel through the wire; the salt bridge completes the ion path.
建议回看主线：先看电子与电流的方向，再看单液为什么衰减，最后看盐桥缺了会怎样。: Try reviewing the main thread: first the directions of electrons and current, then why a single solution decays, and finally what happens without the salt bridge.
电子（橙，Zn → Cu）与电流（蓝，Cu → Zn）: Electrons (orange, Zn → Cu) and current (blue, Cu → Zn)
盐桥：K⁺ → CuSO₄ 池，Cl⁻ → ZnSO₄ 池: Salt bridge: K⁺ → CuSO₄ beaker, Cl⁻ → ZnSO₄ beaker
电极表面的气泡（Zn 面自放电、Cu 面 H₂↑）: Bubbles on the electrode surfaces (Zn self-discharge, H₂↑ on Cu)
Cu 片上沉积的铜: Copper deposited on the Cu strip
电极表面与盐桥 · 示意放大: Electrode surfaces and salt bridge · schematic close-up
示意放大 · 正在看：① 单液: Magnified view · now viewing: ① one solution
示意放大 · 正在看：② 双液: Magnified view · now viewing: ② two solutions
一只 250 mL 烧杯装稀硫酸，锌片、铜片插在里面（教材图6-6）: One 250 mL beaker of dilute sulfuric acid with a zinc strip and a copper strip in it (textbook Fig. 6-6)
ZnSO₄ 池插锌片、CuSO₄ 池插铜片，中间一根含 KCl 琼脂的盐桥（教材: A zinc strip in a ZnSO₄ beaker, a copper strip in a CuSO₄ beaker, and a salt bridge of KCl agar between them (textbook Fig. 4-1)
中央零刻度灵敏电流计 G（±15 mA，分度 0.1 mA）与两条带鳄鱼夹的导线: A center-zero galvanometer G (±15 mA, 0.1 mA divisions) and two wires with alligator clips, clipped to whichever setup is selected
台面后方的放大视窗：Zn 面失电子、Cu 面得电子、盐桥里的 K⁺ 与 Cl⁻（: Magnified window at the back of the bench: Zn surface losing electrons, Cu surface gaining electrons, K⁺ and Cl⁻ in the salt bridge (schematic close-up)
桌上摆着两套装置，为什么同一块锌片要试两次？: There are two setups on the bench. Why try the same zinc strip twice?
拖动视角，绕这张台面看一圈（滚轮可拉近）: Drag the view around the bench (scroll to zoom)
三站都在：① 一杯稀硫酸插着锌片和铜片、② 两杯（ZnSO₄ / CuSO₄）中: All three stations are here: ① one beaker of dilute sulfuric acid with zinc and copper strips, ② two beakers (ZnSO₄ / CuSO₄) with a salt bridge between them, ③ the galvanometer in the middle with two wires, now clipped to ①. Main reading 7.3 mA (one solution, 0.50 mol/L, just connected), EMF 0.76 V
两套装置的区别只有两处：一杯酸还是两杯、盐桥插没插。: The two setups differ in just two ways: one beaker or two, and whether the salt bridge is in.
电流表是唯一能把「有没有电流」变成数的仪器（分度 0.1 mA）。: The ammeter is the only instrument that turns "is there a current" into a number (0.1 mA divisions).
左边这套已经有读数，说明单液装置不是「错的」，只是有代价。: The left setup already gives a reading, so the single-solution cell isn't "wrong"; it just has a cost.
去掉这一步：学生以为原电池只有一种样子，第 4、5 步的对比就没有参照。: Skip this step and students think a galvanic cell has only one form, leaving steps 4 and 5 with nothing to compare against.
常考：原电池的构成要素（电极、电解质溶液、导线、闭合回路）——教材实验活动6 的: Commonly tested: the parts of a galvanic cell (electrodes, electrolyte solution, wire, closed circuit), question 1 of textbook Lab Activity 6.
左边这套是必修课做过的：一杯稀硫酸、两片金属、一根导线就有电流；右边这套多了一根: The left setup is from the required course: one beaker of dilute sulfuric acid, two metal strips and a wire give a current; the right setup adds a salt bridge, which is the "why" this lesson asks about.
把两根导线夹上去，铜片上凭什么冒出气泡？: Clip on the two wires. Why do bubbles appear on the copper strip?
把导线夹上（刚进来是断开的），看铜片上发生了什么: Clip the wires on (they start disconnected) and see what happens on the copper strip
断开时电流 0.0 mA：锌片上有气泡、铜片上没有；接通后读数 7.3 mA，铜: Disconnected, the current is 0.0 mA: bubbles on the zinc, none on the copper; connected, the reading is 7.3 mA and the copper bubbles too, while the bubbles on the zinc decrease but don't disappear (70 % self-discharge)
断开导线时锌片冒气泡，是锌与稀硫酸直接反应，与导线无关。: With the wires off, the bubbles on zinc come from zinc reacting directly with the acid, nothing to do with the wire.
接通后气泡跑到铜片上，说明电子确实经导线到了铜片。: Once connected, bubbles move to the copper strip, showing electrons really do reach the copper through the wire.
锌片上还剩气泡，说明单液装置里化学能有一部分没走导线（第 4 步量化）。: Bubbles remain on the zinc, showing that in the single-solution setup some chemical energy doesn't go through the wire (quantified in step 4).
去掉这一步：学生看到锌片冒气泡就以为它「正在放电」。: Skip this step and students see bubbles on zinc and think it's "discharging".
高频：为什么接通后气泡出现在不活泼的铜片上（2H⁺ + 2e⁻ = H₂↑）。: Frequently tested: why bubbles appear on the less reactive copper strip once connected (2H⁺ + 2e⁻ = H₂↑).
电子由锌片通过导线流向铜片；溶液中的 H⁺ 从铜片获得电子被还原成氢原子，结合成: Electrons flow from the zinc strip through the wire to the copper strip; H⁺ in the solution takes electrons from the copper strip, is reduced to hydrogen atoms, which combine into H₂ released from the copper strip (textbook wording).
电流表指针偏了，到底是电子在流还是电流在流？往哪边？: The ammeter needle moved. Is it electrons or current that flows, and which way?
点一下电流表，看指针偏转，再看导线上两种箭头各往哪边: Tap the ammeter to see the needle deflect, then look at which way the two kinds of arrows on the wire point
指针发生偏转（偏哪边取决于电流表怎么接，本课不看它）；导线上橙色箭头是电子（Zn: The needle deflects (which way depends on how the ammeter is connected; this lesson ignores that); the orange arrows on the wire are electrons (Zn → Cu), the blue arrows are current (Cu → Zn, opposite to the electrons). Current 7.3 mA and EMF 0.76 V stay the same
电子 Zn → Cu · 电流 Cu → Zn: Electrons Zn → Cu · current Cu → Zn
导线里只有电子 · 0.50 mol/L · 7.3 mA: Only electrons in the wire · 0.50 mol/L · 7.3 mA
「负极」是按电子流出命名的，不是按电压高低命名的。: The "negative electrode" is named for electrons flowing out, not for having lower voltage.
电流方向是历史约定的正电荷流向，所以与电子方向相反——每年都有人错在这里。: Current direction is the historical convention for positive charge flow, so it's opposite to electron flow; people get this wrong every year.
导线里只有电子在流，离子不走导线（第 7 步讲离子走哪条路）。: Only electrons flow in the wire; ions don't travel through the wire (step 7 covers where ions go).
去掉这一步：学生把电流方向当成电子方向，画图和分析全反。: Skip this step and students take current direction as electron direction, reversing every diagram and analysis.
高频：判断正负极、画电子与电流方向；「电子流出的一极是负极」。: Frequently tested: identifying positive and negative electrodes, drawing electron and current directions; "the electrode electrons flow out of is the negative one".
电子流出的一极是负极（锌片被氧化），电子流入的一极是正极（铜片，H⁺ 在正极上被: The electrode electrons flow out of is the negative electrode (zinc, oxidized); the one they flow into is the positive electrode (copper, where H⁺ is reduced); current flows opposite to electron motion (textbook wording).
单液电池放着不管，电流为什么越来越小？: Leave a single-solution cell running. Why does the current keep falling?
把「通电时间」从 0 拖到 10 min、再拖到 30 min，盯住电流表: Drag "Running time" from 0 to 10 min, then to 30 min, watching the ammeter
单液 0.50 mol/L：通电 0 min 7.3 mA → 10 min 2: One solution, 0.50 mol/L: 0 min 7.3 mA → 10 min 2.1 mA → 30 min 0.2 mA; the two-solution cell stays at 10.5 mA the whole time. The zinc surface keeps bubbling (70 % self-discharge, chemical energy turned straight into heat)
Zn + 2H⁺ = Zn²⁺ + H₂↑（不经导线）: Zn + 2H⁺ = Zn²⁺ + H₂↑ (not through the wire)
衰减不是「电池没电了」，是锌被酸白白消耗掉了。: The decay isn't "the battery ran flat"; zinc is being wasted by the acid.
自放电的 70 % 不走导线，那部分化学能直接变成热，不做功。: The 70 % self-discharge doesn't go through the wire; that chemical energy becomes heat directly and does no work.
双液同一时段读数纹丝不动，差别不在电极材料，而在「Zn 有没有和酸直接接触」。: The two-solution reading doesn't budge over the same time; the difference isn't the electrode material but "whether Zn touches the acid directly".
去掉这一步：学生会觉得换双液只是「更高级」，说不清代价在哪。: Skip this step and students think switching to two solutions is just "more advanced", unable to say what the cost was.
高频：单液原电池的缺点（电流衰减、锌直接反应）；教材为什么改用盐桥。: Frequently tested: the drawbacks of a single-solution cell (current decays, zinc reacts directly); why the textbook switches to a salt bridge.
这种原电池中氧化反应与还原反应并没有完全隔开，锌与其接触的稀硫酸发生反应，电流会: In this cell the oxidation and reduction aren't fully separated: zinc reacts with the dilute sulfuric acid it touches, and the current gradually decays (textbook wording).
A4.4、A4.1、A5.2、B1 表、B2.1 算子 3、标准值表 1/4/5: A4.4, A4.1, A5.2, B1 table, B2.1 operator 3, standard values tables 1/4/5, D5
换成两杯溶液、插上盐桥，为什么读数反而更大也更稳？: With two beakers and a salt bridge, why is the reading both larger and steadier?
把「装置」拨到双液（盐桥已经插好），看读数和两极表面: Switch "Setup" to two solutions (the salt bridge is already in) and look at the reading and both electrode surfaces
电流 7.3 → 10.5 mA，电动势 0.76 → 1.10 V（高 0.3: Current 7.3 → 10.5 mA, EMF 0.76 → 1.10 V (0.34 V higher); the zinc no longer bubbles (0 % self-discharge), and a copper-colored deposit appears on the copper strip (Cu²⁺ + 2e⁻ = Cu)
总反应 Zn + Cu²⁺ = Zn²⁺ + Cu · 0.50 mol/L: Overall reaction Zn + Cu²⁺ = Zn²⁺ + Cu · 0.50 mol/L
电压变高是因为正极换了半反应：从 H⁺/H₂（0 V）换到 Cu²⁺/Cu（+0: The voltage is higher because the positive electrode uses a different half-reaction: from H⁺/H₂ (0 V) to Cu²⁺/Cu (+0.3419 V).
锌片不再冒气泡，说明它不再和酸直接接触——单液的毛病被装置结构消除了。: The zinc stops bubbling, showing it no longer touches acid directly: the setup's structure removes the single-solution flaw.
铜片上出现的是铜（沉积），不是气泡，两者不要混。: What appears on the copper strip is copper (a deposit), not bubbles; don't mix them up.
去掉这一步：学生只知道「加盐桥有电流」，不知道两池各管一半反应才是关键。: Skip this step and students only know "add a salt bridge and there's current", missing that each beaker handling half the reaction is the key.
高频：双液原电池的正负极反应与总反应；Cu 片上为什么是镀铜而不是气泡。: Frequently tested: electrode and overall reactions of the two-solution cell; why the Cu strip gets plated with copper rather than bubbles.
Zn 失去电子变成 Zn²⁺ 进入溶液，电子由负极经导线流向正极，正极一端的 C: Zn loses electrons and enters the solution as Zn²⁺; electrons flow from the negative electrode through the wire to the positive, where Cu²⁺ gains electrons and deposits as Cu on the copper strip (textbook wording).
A2.3、A4.6、A5.3、B1 表、B2.1 算子 1、标准值表 7、D4、: A2.3, A4.6, A5.3, B1 table, B2.1 operator 1, standard values table 7, D4, D9
只是抽走一根装着琼脂的管子，电流凭什么归零？: You only removed a tube of agar. Why does the current drop to zero?
把盐桥拔出来，看指针；再插回去看恢复: Pull out the salt bridge and watch the needle; then put it back and watch it recover
拔出盐桥：电流 10.5 → 0.0 mA，指针回到零点，电动势那格变成「—（离: Salt bridge out: current 10.5 → 0.0 mA, the needle returns to zero, and the EMF cell shows "— (ion path broken)": with no ion path between the beakers, no meter can read an EMF. Put it back and it immediately recovers to 10.5 mA and 1.10 V
Zn ｜ ZnSO₄ ‖ KCl 盐桥 ‖ CuSO₄ ｜ Cu: Zn | ZnSO₄ ‖ KCl salt bridge ‖ CuSO₄ | Cu
盐桥插上 → 拔出 · 0.50 mol/L · 电流 10.5 → 0.0 m: Salt bridge in → out · 0.50 mol/L · current 10.5 → 0.0 mA
闭合回路必须同时有电子导体（导线）和离子导体（溶液 + 盐桥）。: A closed circuit needs both an electronic conductor (the wire) and an ionic conductor (solution + salt bridge).
电池并没有坏：把盐桥插回去，开路电压仍是 1.10 V——断的是离子通路，不是电: The cell isn't broken: put the salt bridge back and the open-circuit voltage is still 1.10 V. What broke was the ion path, not the electrodes.
盐桥里是 KCl 饱和溶液的琼脂，离子可在其中自由移动——它提供离子通路，不提供: The salt bridge holds agar made with saturated KCl solution, in which ions move freely: it provides an ion path, not electrons.
去掉这一步：学生以为「有电就是导线的事」，答不到离子导体。: Skip this step and students think "electricity is all about the wire" and miss the ionic conductor.
高频：盐桥的作用（形成闭合回路、平衡电荷）；拔掉盐桥为什么没有电流。: Frequently tested: the role of the salt bridge (completing the circuit, balancing charge); why there's no current without it.
从上述装置中取出盐桥，电流表的指针又回到零点，即电路中没有电流通过（教材原话）。: Remove the salt bridge from the setup and the ammeter needle returns to zero: no current flows in the circuit (textbook wording).
A4.5、A1.6、A2.6、B1 表、标准值表 7/12、D3: A4.5, A1.6, A2.6, B1 table, standard values tables 7/12, D3
电子走导线，那溶液里的电谁来补？: Electrons go through the wire, so who balances the charge in the solution?
点一下台面后方的放大视窗，看两极表面与盐桥里的粒子往哪边走: Tap the magnified window at the back of the bench and see which way the particles at the electrode surfaces and in the salt bridge move
视窗里左半（锌）表面电子向外走、Zn²⁺ 进入溶液；右半（铜）表面电子进来、Cu: In the window, on the left (zinc) electrons leave the surface and Zn²⁺ enters the solution; on the right (copper) electrons arrive and Cu²⁺ becomes deposited Cu; in the salt bridge in the middle K⁺ moves toward the CuSO₄ beaker and Cl⁻ toward the ZnSO₄ beaker (3 of each drawn, schematic close-up)
K⁺ → CuSO₄ 池 · Cl⁻ → ZnSO₄ 池: K⁺ → CuSO₄ beaker · Cl⁻ → ZnSO₄ beaker
示意放大 · 正在看：② 双液原电池: Magnified view · now viewing: ② two-solution cell
电子只在导线里走，离子只在溶液和盐桥里走，两条路互不串。: Electrons travel only in the wire and ions only in the solution and salt bridge; the two paths never cross.
阳离子往正极一侧去（K⁺ 去 CuSO₄），阴离子往负极一侧去（Cl⁻ 去 Zn: Cations move toward the positive side (K⁺ to CuSO₄), anions toward the negative side (Cl⁻ to ZnSO₄), in opposite directions.
盐桥补的是电荷平衡：没有它，一侧正电荷越积越多，反应就走不下去。: The salt bridge maintains charge balance: without it, positive charge would pile up on one side and the reaction would stall.
去掉这一步：学生只会背「盐桥沟通两池」，画不出离子往哪边走。: Skip this step and students only recite "the salt bridge connects the beakers" and can't draw which way the ions go.
高频：盐桥中离子的迁移方向；阴、阳离子在溶液中的移动方向。: Frequently tested: the direction of ion migration in the salt bridge; which way anions and cations move in solution.
盐桥中的 Cl⁻ 移向 ZnSO₄ 溶液，K⁺ 移向 CuSO₄ 溶液，使氧化还: Cl⁻ in the salt bridge moves toward the ZnSO₄ solution and K⁺ toward the CuSO₄ solution, so the redox reaction keeps going and the zinc-copper cell keeps producing current (textbook wording).
把溶液配浓一点，读数为什么会变大？: Why does the reading go up when you make the solutions more concentrated?
把电解质浓度从 0.05 拖到 1.00 mol/L，同时看电流和曲线: Drag the electrolyte concentration from 0.05 to 1.00 mol/L, watching the current and the curve
Two solutions: 0.05 mol/L 9.5 mA → 0.50 10.5 mA → 1.00 10.7 mA, with the EMF steady at 1.10 V; the single-solution cell also rises with concentration (6.6 → 7.3 → 7.4 mA). With the wires disconnected: current 0.0 mA, but the EMF still reads 1.10 V (open-circuit voltage)
浓度改的是「路好不好走」（内阻），不是「推力有多大」（电动势）——前提是两池浓度: Concentration changes "how easy the path is" (internal resistance), not "how hard it pushes" (EMF). This assumes both beakers have equal concentrations changed together, so the Nernst terms cancel; if only one side gets more concentrated, the EMF changes too.
电动势由两极的材料与反应物决定（教材：输出电能的能力取决于反应物的氧化还原能力）: The EMF is set by the electrode materials and reactants (textbook: the ability to deliver electrical energy depends on the reactants' redox ability).
断开导线时电流为 0 而电动势仍读到 1.10 V（开路电压），说明「有电压」不: With the wires disconnected the current is 0 but the EMF still reads 1.10 V (open-circuit voltage): "there's a voltage" doesn't mean "there's a current".
去掉这一步：学生以为加深溶液能让电压变高。: Skip this step and students think a more concentrated solution raises the voltage.
高频：原电池输出能力取决于什么（反应物的氧化还原能力），不是电极面积或溶液多少。: Frequently tested: what a galvanic cell's output depends on (the reactants' redox ability), not electrode area or volume of solution.
浓度变大，溶液导电能力变强、电池内阻变小，所以同样电动势下电流更大；电动势由两极: Higher concentration makes the solution conduct better and lowers the cell's internal resistance, so the same EMF gives more current; the EMF is set by the electrode reactants, not the solution concentration.
A4.7、B1 表、B2.1 算子 2、标准值表 8/9/13、D6: A4.7, B1 table, B2.1 operator 2, standard values tables 8/9/13, D6
考核：把台面调成一台能稳定输出电流的锌铜原电池: Assessment: set up the bench as a zinc-copper cell that delivers a steady current
双液 + 盐桥插上 + 导线接通 + 浓度 ≥ 0.50 mol/L，让电流 ≥: Two solutions + salt bridge in + wires connected + concentration ≥ 0.50 mol/L, so the current is ≥ 10.0 mA, held for 15 seconds; partway through the salt bridge will be pulled out
达标横幅「原电池 · 组装达标」；进入 5 s 后盐桥被拔掉（电流 10.5 →: Pass banner "Galvanic cell · assembled"; at 5 s the salt bridge is pulled out (current 10.5 → 0.0 mA) and you must put it back. The reference setup, 0.50 mol/L with two solutions and both salt bridge and wires in, reads 10.5 mA
双液 · 0.50 mol/L · 电流 ≥ 10.0 mA · 保持 15 s: Two solutions · 0.50 mol/L · current ≥ 10.0 mA · hold 15 s
装置选双液：单液一开始就有 6.6–7.3 mA，但达不到 10.0 mA，而且: Choose two solutions: one solution starts at 6.6–7.3 mA but can't reach 10.0 mA, and it decays.
盐桥与导线是两个独立的「通路」，缺一个电流就是 0。: The salt bridge and the wire are two separate "paths"; missing either one makes the current 0.
浓度要够（≥ 0.50 mol/L），否则内阻拖住电流。: The concentration must be high enough (≥ 0.50 mol/L), or internal resistance holds the current back.
满分结构：双液 + 盐桥 + 导线 + 浓度，四件事缺一不可。: Full-marks structure: two solutions + salt bridge + wire + concentration. All four are needed.
考核没有新结论：把「两池分开、盐桥插好、导线接通、溶液够浓」四件事同时照顾好，电: The assessment has no new conclusion: only by handling all four at once (separate beakers, salt bridge in, wire connected, solution concentrated enough) is the current both large and steady.
单液（一杯稀硫酸）: One solution (one beaker of dilute H₂SO₄)
— 当前装置 · ┈ 另一套装置 · ● 当前工况: — current setup · ┈ other setup · ● current state
本班目标：组装一台能稳定输出电流的锌铜原电池——双液、盐桥插上、导线接通、浓度: Class goal: assemble a zinc-copper cell with a steady current: two solutions, salt bridge in, wires connected, concentration ≥ 0.50 mol/L, current ≥ 10.0 mA held for 15 seconds (textbook Exp. 4-1)
锌片、铜片用导线连接后插入稀硫酸，下列判断正确的是: Zinc and copper strips joined by a wire are dipped into dilute sulfuric acid. Which statement is correct?
锌是正极，因为锌溶解得快: Zinc is the positive electrode because it dissolves quickly
锌是负极，电子由锌经导线流向铜: Zinc is the negative electrode, and electrons flow from zinc through the wire to copper
铜是负极，因为铜片上有气泡: Copper is the negative electrode because there are bubbles on it
电子由铜经导线流向锌: Electrons flow from copper through the wire to zinc
电子流出的一极是负极：锌被氧化，Zn − 2e⁻ = Zn²⁺，电子经导线流向铜: The electrode electrons flow out of is the negative one: zinc is oxidized, Zn − 2e⁻ = Zn²⁺, and electrons flow through the wire to the copper strip, where 2H⁺ + 2e⁻ = H₂↑ produces the bubbles (textbook Required Book 2, pp.36–37).
关于原电池外电路中的电子与电流方向，正确的是: Which correctly describes the electron and current directions in a galvanic cell's external circuit?
电子与电流都由负极流向正极: Both electrons and current flow from negative to positive
电子由负极流向正极，电流方向与之相反: Electrons flow from negative to positive, and current flows the opposite way
电子由正极流向负极，电流方向与之相同: Electrons flow from positive to negative, and current flows the same way
电子与电流方向都由正极流向负极: Both electrons and current flow from positive to negative
电子由负极（锌）经导线流向正极（铜）；电流方向是正电荷流向的约定，因此与电子运动: Electrons flow from the negative electrode (zinc) through the wire to the positive (copper); current direction is the convention for positive charge flow, so it's opposite to electron motion. In this lesson the orange (electron) and blue (current) arrows on the wire are a pair pointing opposite ways.
锌铜双液原电池工作时，盐桥中离子的迁移方向是: While a zinc-copper two-solution cell is working, ions in the salt bridge migrate as follows
K⁺ 移向 ZnSO₄ 溶液，Cl⁻ 移向 CuSO₄ 溶液: K⁺ moves to the ZnSO₄ solution, Cl⁻ moves to the CuSO₄ solution
K⁺ 移向 CuSO₄ 溶液，Cl⁻ 移向 ZnSO₄ 溶液: K⁺ moves to the CuSO₄ solution, Cl⁻ moves to the ZnSO₄ solution
K⁺ 与 Cl⁻ 都移向 CuSO₄ 溶液: Both K⁺ and Cl⁻ move to the CuSO₄ solution
K⁺ 与 Cl⁻ 都移向 ZnSO₄ 溶液: Both K⁺ and Cl⁻ move to the ZnSO₄ solution
教材原话：盐桥中的 Cl⁻ 移向 ZnSO₄ 溶液，K⁺ 移向 CuSO₄ 溶液: Textbook wording: Cl⁻ in the salt bridge moves toward the ZnSO₄ solution and K⁺ toward the CuSO₄ solution. Cations go to the positive side (the CuSO₄ beaker), anions to the negative side (the ZnSO₄ beaker).
锌铜双液原电池的正极反应是: The positive electrode reaction of the zinc-copper two-solution cell is
双液装置的正极是 CuSO₄ 溶液中的 Cu²⁺ 得电子沉积成 Cu；2H⁺ +: In the two-solution setup, the positive electrode is where Cu²⁺ from the CuSO₄ solution gains electrons and deposits as Cu; 2H⁺ + 2e⁻ = H₂↑ is the positive electrode reaction of the single-solution (dilute sulfuric acid) setup. Don't mix them up.
单液原电池（锌、铜插在稀硫酸中）工作时间长了电流会衰减，主要原因是: A single-solution cell (zinc and copper in dilute sulfuric acid) loses current over time, mainly because
锌与它接触的稀硫酸直接反应，被白白消耗: Zinc reacts directly with the acid it touches and is wasted
稀硫酸中的 H⁺ 全部被消耗完: All the H⁺ in the dilute sulfuric acid is used up
铜片被氧化成 Cu²⁺ 进入溶液: The copper strip is oxidized to Cu²⁺ and enters the solution
导线发热使电阻变得无限大: The wire heats up until its resistance becomes infinite
教材原话：这种原电池中氧化反应与还原反应并没有完全隔开，如锌与其接触的稀硫酸发生: Textbook wording: in this cell oxidation and reduction aren't fully separated; for example, zinc reacts with the dilute sulfuric acid it touches, and the current gradually decays. This lesson labels the part that bypasses the wire as 70 % self-discharge; that chemical energy turns straight into heat.
把锌铜双液原电池的盐桥取出，电流表指针回到零点，原因是: When the salt bridge is removed from a zinc-copper two-solution cell, the ammeter needle returns to zero because
电池的电动势变成了零: The cell's EMF has become zero
两个半电池之间失去离子通路，回路不闭合: The two half-cells lose their ion path, so the circuit isn't closed
铜片不再能导电: The copper strip can no longer conduct
硫酸锌溶液中的 Zn²⁺ 被消耗完了: The Zn²⁺ in the zinc sulfate solution has been used up
取出盐桥后两个半电池之间没有离子导体，电荷无法平衡，回路不闭合，所以没有电流（连: With the salt bridge removed there's no ionic conductor between the half-cells, charge can't balance and the circuit isn't closed, so there's no current (not even an EMF reading). A closed circuit needs an electronic conductor (wire) and an ionic conductor (solution + salt bridge); put the salt bridge back and the open-circuit voltage is still 1.10 V.
装置换成双液：电动势 0.76 → 1.10 V，电流表读数变大，Zn 不再与酸: Setup switched to two solutions: EMF 0.76 → 1.10 V, the ammeter reading rises, and Zn no longer touches the acid directly
装置换回单液：电动势 0.76 V，锌片又和稀硫酸直接反应（自放电 70 %）: Setup switched back to one solution: EMF 0.76 V, and the zinc reacts directly with the dilute sulfuric acid again (70 % self-discharge)
盐桥插上：离子通路接通，回路闭合: Salt bridge in: ion path connected, circuit closed
盐桥拔出：离子通路断开，电流表回到零点，电动势也读不出来: Salt bridge out: ion path broken, the ammeter returns to zero, and the EMF can't be read either
导线断开：电流为 0，但电压表仍能读到电动势: Wires disconnected: current is 0, but a voltmeter still reads the EMF
异常：盐桥被拔掉了——电流归零，先把它插回去: Fault: the salt bridge was pulled out. The current drops to zero, so put it back first
已回到参考工况：单液 · 0.50 mol/L · 导线接通 · 刚接通（7.3: Back to the reference setup: one solution · 0.50 mol/L · wires connected · just connected (7.3 mA)
本课目标：先看清单液装置里电子与电流的方向，再弄清它为什么会衰减 → 换成双液: Lesson goal: first see the electron and current directions in the single-solution setup, then understand why it decays → switch to two solutions + salt bridge and see that each beaker handles half the reaction and the salt bridge completes the ion path → finally assemble a zinc-copper cell with a large, steady current and pass the assessment.

Apparatus and procedures come from PEP Required Book 2 Fig. 6-6, Exp. 6-3 and Lab Activity 6 (printed p.36, pp.56–57) and Selective Required Book 1 Fig. 4-1 and Exp. 4-1 (printed pp.96–97). Standard electrode potentials are CRC Handbook values (E°(Zn²⁺/Zn) = −0.7618 V, E°(Cu²⁺/Cu) = +0.3419 V); the current and EMF on screen are model readings computed as E/(R_ext + R_int), with the EMF shown to two decimal places.
